project.name: UK CAER TCS Digital Twin PM Package
project.description: 371-file construction PM system implementing TCS (Total Control System) digital-twin package for UK CAER Outreach & Education Center (DeVere Construction). 51 Python builders generate XLSX workbooks and HTML interactive boards across 10 business domains.

nodes.name: UK CAER TCS Package
nodes.summary: 371-file digital-twin PM package — 51 Python builders, 36 XLSX workbooks, 22 HTML boards, 225 Markdown docs, 10 business domains

nodes.name: Build Scripts (51 Python + 1 JS)
nodes.summary: 51 Python scripts (build_uk_caer_*.py) each generate one TCS deliverable. 1 Node.js orchestrator (build_uk_caer_pm_master_control.mjs) sequences all builds.

nodes.name: Governance & Control Docs (80+ MD)
nodes.summary: Gate readiness READMEs, Sage governance brief, validation architecture, PM harness continuity, premobilization ledgers, doctrine, evidence token standards, receipts

nodes.name: TCS Onboarding Package (112+ MD)
nodes.summary: 8-week syllabus, RACI matrix, exercises, project packs (Richmond, Chokshi, Franklin, Owen County), Day-1 field guides, buildspecs, 6 PPTX slide decks

nodes.name: Generated Workbooks (36 XLSX)
nodes.summary: TCS deliverable workbooks: WBS, Control Pack, Schedule Logic, Action Plans, Field WI/ITP, BOQ/BOM, Safety/Quality, RFI Register, PM Command Center, Executive Overview

nodes.name: Interactive Boards (22 HTML)
nodes.summary: 16 generated TCS boards (Gate Readiness, Evidence Intake, Procurement, Daily PM, Validation Zone, PM Asset Navigator) + 3 workflow visuals + Owner View + Compliance Milestones

nodes.name: Source Data (21 TXT, 4 JSON, 4 PDF)
nodes.summary: PDF extraction caches (specs/drawings/addenda), Owen County email transcripts, NotebookLM studio exports, owner review audio script

nodes.name: Skill Drafts & Agent Configs (3 YAML)
